caption: The drawing depicts a round metal grill with three short legs and a long, slightly angled handle attached to one side. The grill surface consists of parallel bars enclosed by a circular frame. The drawing is done in shades of black and gray on an off-white or beige background. The handle is flat with a diamond-shaped hole at the end. Above the main detailed view, there are two technical schematic views: a top view showing the grill as a circle with inner parallel lines and a side profile showing the relative height of the legs and the shape of the handle. Below the side profile is a horizontal line marked with measurements in inches. The artist’s name, "Filippo Berreca," is written in cursive in the lower left corner. The entire drawing is bordered by a single-line rectangular frame.
title: Trivet
